## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` is green
- [ ] Docs: `README.md` for user-visible changes, `AGENTS.md` for structural ones
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md`: a line under `## Unreleased` for anything a user would notice
- [ ] Reviewed by someone or something other than the author before merge
